changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: Creates the table that keeps the original value of every observation key changed by the changesets below. key_existed records whether the key was present, so a rollback can remove a key it added instead of leaving an empty one behind.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup ( hts_encounter_id BIGINT NOT NULL, field_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, hts_encounter_uuid VARCHAR(255), key_existed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT, old_date_modified TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, old_last_modified_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, backed_up_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT pk_hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup PRIMARY KEY (hts_encounter_id, field_name) );

changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: initialHivTest: STI_HIV_RESULT_POSITIVE -> HIV_TEST_RESULT_POSITIVE, STI_HIV_RESULT_NEGATIVE -> HIV_TEST_RESULT_NEGATIVE. Archived rows are included so a record that is later restored is already correct. last_modified_date is bumped so the corrected rows are picked up by sync.
changeSet.sql: WITH legacy AS ( SELECT e.id, e.uuid, e.date_modified, e.last_modified_date, e.observation->>'initialHivTest' AS old_value, 'HIV_TEST_RESULT_' || substr(upper(btrim(e.observation->>'initialHivTest')), 16) AS new_value FROM hts_encounter e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.observation->'initialHivTest') = 'string' AND upper(btrim(e.observation->>'initialHivTest')) IN ('STI_HIV_RESULT_POSITIVE', 'STI_HIV_RESULT_NEGATIVE') ), backup AS ( INSERT INTO hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup (hts_encounter_id, field_name, hts_encounter_uuid, key_existed, old_value, new_value, old_date_modified, old_last_modified_date) SELECT l.id, 'initialHivTest', l.uuid, true, l.old_value, l.new_value, l.date_modified, l.last_modified_date FROM legacy l ON CONFLICT (hts_encounter_id, field_name) DO NOTHING ) UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = jsonb_set(e.observation, '{initialHivTest}', to_jsonb(l.new_value), false), date_modified = now(), last_modified_date = now() FROM legacy l WHERE l.id = e.id;

rollback.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = jsonb_set(e.observation, '{initialHivTest}', to_jsonb(b.old_value), false), date_modified = b.old_date_modified, last_modified_date = now() FROM hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup b WHERE b.hts_encounter_id = e.id AND b.field_name = 'initialHivTest' AND e.observation->>'initialHivTest' = b.new_value;

changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: confirmatoryHivTest: STI_HIV_RESULT_POSITIVE -> HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_POSITIVE, STI_HIV_RESULT_NEGATIVE -> HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_NEGATIVE. Without this, the HTS eligibility, duplicate-positive, ICT and index-testing checks do not see these results.
changeSet.sql: WITH legacy AS ( SELECT e.id, e.uuid, e.date_modified, e.last_modified_date, e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' AS old_value, 'HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_' || substr(upper(btrim(e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest')), 16) AS new_value FROM hts_encounter e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.observation->'confirmatoryHivTest') = 'string' AND upper(btrim(e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest')) IN ('STI_HIV_RESULT_POSITIVE', 'STI_HIV_RESULT_NEGATIVE') ), backup AS ( INSERT INTO hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup (hts_encounter_id, field_name, hts_encounter_uuid, key_existed, old_value, new_value, old_date_modified, old_last_modified_date) SELECT l.id, 'confirmatoryHivTest', l.uuid, true, l.old_value, l.new_value, l.date_modified, l.last_modified_date FROM legacy l ON CONFLICT (hts_encounter_id, field_name) DO NOTHING ) UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = jsonb_set(e.observation, '{confirmatoryHivTest}', to_jsonb(l.new_value), false), date_modified = now(), last_modified_date = now() FROM legacy l WHERE l.id = e.id;

rollback.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = jsonb_set(e.observation, '{confirmatoryHivTest}', to_jsonb(b.old_value), false), date_modified = b.old_date_modified, last_modified_date = now() FROM hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup b WHERE b.hts_encounter_id = e.id AND b.field_name = 'confirmatoryHivTest' AND e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = b.new_value;

changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: The July backfill (backfill_final_hiv_test_result) could not derive finalHivTestResult for records whose confirmatoryHivTest held an STI_HIV_RESULT code. For records corrected above only, and only where finalHivTestResult is missing or empty, this derives it with the same rules as DiagnosticTestingSection.jsx. A blank typeOfHivTestDone is treated as Rapid Antibody, the only path that existed before Early Detect. Existing results are never overwritten, and nothing is written when no rule applies.
changeSet.sql: WITH derived AS ( SELECT e.id, e.uuid, jsonb_exists(e.observation, 'finalHivTestResult') AS key_existed, e.observation->>'finalHivTestResult' AS old_value, e.date_modified, e.last_modified_date, CASE WHEN coalesce(e.observation->>'typeOfHivTestDone', '') IN ('', 'TYPE_OF_HIV_TEST_RAPID_ANTIBODY') THEN CASE WHEN e.observation->>'initialHivTest' = 'HIV_TEST_RESULT_NEGATIVE' THEN 'Negative' WHEN e.observation->>'initialHivTest' = 'HIV_TEST_RESULT_POSITIVE' THEN CASE WHEN e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = 'HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_POSITIVE' THEN 'Positive' WHEN e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = 'HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_NEGATIVE' THEN 'Negative' END END WHEN e.observation->>'typeOfHivTestDone' = 'TYPE_OF_HIV_TEST_HIV_EARLY_DETECT' AND e.observation->>'hivEarlyDetectResult' = 'HIV_EARLY_DETECT_RESULT_ANTIBODY_REACTIVE' THEN CASE WHEN e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = 'HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_POSITIVE' THEN 'Positive' WHEN e.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = 'HIV_CONFIRMATORY_TEST_RESULT_NEGATIVE' THEN 'Negative' END END AS new_value FROM hts_encounter e WHERE e.id IN (SELECT b.hts_encounter_id FROM hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup b WHERE b.field_name IN ('initialHivTest', 'confirmatoryHivTest')) AND coalesce(btrim(e.observation->>'finalHivTestResult'), '') = '' ), backup AS ( INSERT INTO hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup (hts_encounter_id, field_name, hts_encounter_uuid, key_existed, old_value, new_value, old_date_modified, old_last_modified_date) SELECT d.id, 'finalHivTestResult', d.uuid, d.key_existed, d.old_value, d.new_value, d.date_modified, d.last_modified_date FROM derived d WHERE d.new_value IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (hts_encounter_id, field_name) DO NOTHING ) UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = jsonb_set(e.observation, '{finalHivTestResult}', to_jsonb(d.new_value), true), date_modified = now(), last_modified_date = now() FROM derived d WHERE d.id = e.id AND d.new_value IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = CASE WHEN b.key_existed THEN jsonb_set(e.observation, '{finalHivTestResult}', to_jsonb(coalesce(b.old_value, '')), false) ELSE e.observation - 'finalHivTestResult' END, date_modified = b.old_date_modified, last_modified_date = now() FROM hts_encounter_sti_hiv_result_backup b WHERE b.hts_encounter_id = e.id AND b.field_name = 'finalHivTestResult' AND e.observation->>'finalHivTestResult' = b.new_value;
